name: Lully
long_description:
At Lully, we’re building the children’s sleep company. We create innovative, thoughtfully-designed, clinically-proven consumer products to help children, and their families, sleep better. 

Our first product, The Sleep Guardian is the only solution for night terrors. Based on our patented, clinically-proven technology, the Sleep Guardian goes under the mattress and uses precisely-timed vibrations to avoid night terror episodes completely. 

The Sleep Guardian is just the initial product in a suite of smart solutions based on our process: combining a user-centric approach with a clinical understanding of sleep to solve unmet problems in children’s sleep. 

Based in San Francisco, Lully was founded by Dr. Andy Rink, a doctor and father, and Varun Boriah, a medical device entrepreneur. 

Lully was spun out of the Stanford Biodesign Fellowship and is backed by Y Combinator, Two Sigma Ventures, Stanford-StartX Fund and Highway1. We’ve partnered with Stanford Sleep and Riley Children’s Hospital in our goal to help families sleep better.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Varun leads Sales at Luminai, helping healthcare organizations drive operational efficiency through AI-enabled process automation. He was most recently SVP, Platform Solutions at Truepill where he managed the entire portfolio of solutions across the pharmacy, telehealth and diagnostics businesses. Prior to Truepill, he was VP, Business Operations & Expansion at Alto Pharmacy leading the nationwide expansion strategy and execution. Previously, co-founder and CEO of Lully, a YC backed company.

founders.title: Founder/CMO
founders.founder_bio: Andy is a Partner at Healthcare Foundry, where he’s been since 2022. A former surgeon, he’s focused his career on healthcare innovation and startups. He co-founded Lully, a YC-backed sleep health startup, and later launched and led Truepill’s nationwide telehealth business. Andy holds an MD from Indiana, a BE from Vanderbilt, and trained at Northwestern and Stanford Biodesign. He lives in Nashville with his wife, two kids, and dog, and enjoys golf, sports, music, food, and wine.
